intent: Improve Nemotron AppNest contract compliance and measure against GLM without weakening validation
screeningOrder: One fresh publisher-creation checkpoint, after both round2 checkpoints are terminal; no overlapping evaluator invocations.
fullPhase: At most one fresh 36-case comparison across all three rounds for a qualifying publisher-creation candidate plus contemporaneous GLM 5.3, concurrency 2, maximum 216 dispatches. No full comparison if the candidate fails the same gate.

limits.reasoningTokens: No explicit reasoning_budget in round3. Completion-token and deadline limits are unchanged.

stopConditions: Existing auth/quota/nonzero reported cost/HTTP202 behavior stops or blocks the evaluator; do not auto-resume
If a screening profile returns only availability failures on its first operation, stop that profile and exclude it; record any interrupted dispatch outcome as unknown
No automatic credit purchase or paid fallback
scope: Synthetic saved responses; no private records
Default configured application model and transport remain unchanged
One exploratory adaptive selection trial, no statistical or universal parity claim
Do not reinterpret or overwrite historical checkpoints
rationale: A primary-source review after reasoning-only completion exhaustion identified an untested publisher recommendation: temperature1.0, top_p0.95. Earlier trials fixed temperature0 and omitted top_p. One additional published-recipe candidate tests this material parameter gap, not case-specific prompt changes. Greedy decoding as a cause remains unproven.
baselineReuse: Historical within-session reference across frozen source snapshots. Verify baseline and GLM initial eight request bodies byte-identical via archived SHA256 receipts and unchanged scenario/scorer files. Not a simultaneous randomized causal baseline. Full selected-vs-GLM run must use same new frozen source.

profileDefinitions.publisher-creation: Same creation checklist; Super low / Ultra medium effort with no hard reasoning budget; temperature 1.0 and top_p 0.95 for creation and unsupported ideas only. Edits and sequences retain baseline temperature 0; guidance retains baseline omitted temperature. All three omit top_p. GLM is unchanged.

amends: Round2 stopping protocol extended before any round3 requests; both round2 candidates failed the unchanged gate. Original plans and all failed results remain preserved. At most one full36candidate+GLM run across the task remains.
baselineCheckpointMeaning: Archive-relative path, resolved after copying into evidence/phase3; sourceBaselineCheckpoint identifies the live output reference.
